mode: read-only design review; no tests run

findings.title: st_dev checks do not reject same-device bind mounts
findings.recommendation: Use RESOLVE_NO_XDEV where available; define and test a mount-boundary-aware fallback (e.g. statx mount IDs) and fail closed when it cannot prove containment.

findings.title: catalog/global lock identity and lifecycle are underspecified
findings.recommendation: Specify one permanent lock object/name, creation-vs-lock ordering, stable identity validation and complete allowlist; test first-start and restart races across processes.

findings.title: PRAGMA database_list path is not an OS file identity proof
findings.recommendation: Either obtain and compare the actual SQLite VFS file identity, or explicitly downgrade the guarantee to the trusted-private-directory threat model and reconcile §2.6/§20 promises.

findings.title: Passing the case HMAC key to a child conflicts with its untrusted boundary
findings.recommendation: Keep key in supervisor and expose narrow MAC operations, or explicitly place the child in the trusted computing base and define process/handle/key lifetime and sidecar trust consequences.

findings.title: Unlocked catalog snapshot conflicts with lock-required replay reads
findings.recommendation: Make all authoritative reads occur under catalog lock; if pre-read remains, it must be non-authoritative and never poison on a partial concurrent append.

findings.title: Windows reparse traversal and handle-safe cleanup deletion need a precise protocol
findings.recommendation: Specify parent-handle-relative traversal and handle-bound delete with fresh file ID/reparse validation, including the close-to-delete replacement window and DACL inheritance.

findings.title: SQLite cleanup sidecars are absent from the exact member allowlist
findings.recommendation: List WAL/SHM/journal exact names and delete only relative to verified case directory handles; reject unknown files rather than globbing.

findings.title: Case-hash logging key and diagnostic log protection are unspecified
findings.recommendation: Define an independent supervisor-only pseudonym key, separate from case HMAC keys, and specify log ACL/mode, rotation, and access.

passes: Fail-closed direction for unsupported filesystem semantics
Quarantine before cleanup and tombstone after deletion
Stable error categories and data-redaction intent
limitations: No approval for production integration or a real classroom pilot
